source.map: City of Portland Johnson Creek Basin plan district (PCC 33.537, Map 537-1) and its subdistricts, as Portland Maps publishes them; flood and trail layers as listed in inputs
source.says: Sites in the South subdistrict, and sites with any portion in the combined flood hazard area, may not exceed 50 percent impervious surface

inputs.taxlots: quadfit s2_lots (data/quadfit_2026-10-30_dd_c6, Metro RLIS taxlots), the lot shapes the screen asks
inputs.subdistricts: plan-subdistricts.geojson, PLDIST JC SUBDIST SOUTH and FLOOD RISK (BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers layer 1, fetched 2026-10-22)

source.method: The South subdistrict outline, plus every lot (10% or more inside the plan district) with at least 1 sq ft inside the South subdistrict or inside the combined flood hazard area (1996 flood inundation area union FEMA SFHA, per the 33.910 definition), each lot traced whole; unioned, closed by +0.75/-0.5 ft, simplified 0.25 ft, precision 0.1 ft. Checked: every traced lot is 90% or more inside; 26 lots not traced share 10% or more because their taxlots overlap a traced lot (stacked or duplicate taxlots), which only makes the screen stricter.
